form.whatsappSectionHint: Meta Developer App — WhatsApp product. Use the Phone number ID from the app; token can be per-property or set globally in server env (WHATSAPP_DEFAULT_ACCESS_TOKEN). Webhook URL: https://your-api/api/v1/webhooks/whatsapp

form.whatsappRulesTitle: Manager cheat sheet: WhatsApp vs our inbox
form.whatsappRulesBody: RentAI shows one thread per guest number. You reply here; we send to WhatsApp when allowed by Meta. Rule of thumb: after the guest’s last message you have about 24 hours to answer without a template. Outside that, or to start a new outbound, you may need an approved template in Meta Business. If delivery fails, it is usually a WhatsApp policy error — not a bug in RentAI.
form.channelListingsIntro: For each channel: first enter the listing ID from that OTA’s extranet (Booking property ID, Airbnb listing id, …). Below that, set the Zodomus room/product id — use “Load from Zodomus” or pick from the room list when Zodomus has several room types.
form.channelsEmptyHint: No OTA channels yet. Add Booking, Airbnb, or both — each row needs its own OTA listing ID from that platform’s extranet.
form.channelsEmptyCompact: To add Booking or Airbnb rows:
form.manualZodomusStandaloneLabel: Zodomus property ID (manual — no channel row)
form.manualZodomusStandaloneHint: Use this only if you skip Booking/Airbnb rows above. Same id Zodomus shows for the property in backoffice — needed for reservation queue, webhooks, and matching imports.
form.manualZodomusQuickHint: You can save with only this ID — use “Save” below. Add a channel row later if you connect Booking/Airbnb.
form.duplicateOtaChannel: Each channel can only appear once. Remove the duplicate row.
form.syncFlowPickIntro: Start by choosing how this listing connects to external platforms. You can change this later.
form.syncFlowUnlockHint: Tap Booking, Airbnb, or “Not linked” above to open the next section.
form.syncFlowNoOtaLead: Without Booking or Airbnb, only iCal import applies — use it to block dates from other calendars.
form.channelPickerIntro: Choose where this listing is primarily distributed. This sets the Zodomus channel used for availability and reservation sync.
form.channelNoneHint: Direct bookings only; iCal import in the next step.
form.objectIdExternalPlaceholder: From extranet (Booking property ID, Airbnb listing id…)
form.zodomusObjectIdPlaceholder: e.g. 1032263001 — or use Load / pick below
form.zodomusObjectIdHint: Internal room or product id in Zodomus for rates and pushing availability — not the same as the OTA listing ID above. Enter it after “Load from Zodomus”, or tap a room in the list when there are multiple types. If Zodomus only has one room type, you can leave this blank.
form.zodomusPropertyIdHintBooking: Booking.com extranet → Property ID (what Zodomus expects as propertyId for this channel).
form.zodomusPropertyIdHintAirbnb: Airbnb listing’s external object id for this channel in Zodomus.
form.icalCollapsibleHint: Subscribe to external .ics feeds as blocked dates — optional.
form.icalBlockIntro: Optional: import other calendars as blocked dates (no guest details).
form.previewNeedId: Enter the OTA listing ID in the first field above first.
form.previewToastMultiRoom: {count} room types found — pick the right one below.
form.previewRoomsSubtitle: Choose the one that matches this RentAI listing.
form.previewRoomsSingle: One room type — change the selection below if needed.
form.previewToastRoomsLoaded: Loaded {count} room types — pick one below.
form.previewToastInvalidPropertyId: Zodomus rejected this id. Use the external object id for this channel (OTA), not a room id from the list.
form.zodomusPropertyIdHintLoad: “Load” calls Zodomus room-rates using the OTA listing ID. It fills the Zodomus room ID here and may fill the listing name — usually not the full street address.
form.zodomusPreviewNoAddressHint: Zodomus «room-rates» usually returns only rooms and rates — not the hotel address. Fill country/city/address manually or from your OTA extranet.
form.previewRoomRatesIntro: Rate plans attached to each room — these IDs are what you’ll use later for pricing and availability rules.
form.previewRoomRatesFootnote: Nightly amounts are not returned here — only rate IDs and labels. Address and country are usually missing from room-rates; fill listing details manually or copy from the OTA extranet.
form.zodomusPropertyIdHint: External id from Zodomus (sandbox / backoffice). Required to sync OTA bookings into the calendar. Leave empty if not connected.
form.zodomusRoomIdHint: Required for availability push when Zodomus has more than one room type for this property — set the room id that matches this RentAI listing. If Zodomus has only one room, you can leave this empty.
form.icalImportUrlsHint: One URL per line — Airbnb, Booking.com export, or other .ics feeds. Invalid lines are ignored. Save the form, then use “Refresh iCal” on the property page.

inbox.whatsappPolicyBody: 1) While the guest has written recently, you can send normal text from RentAI — it goes to WhatsApp as a regular message. 2) If the guest has been silent for a long time, WhatsApp may block a free-form first message: Meta then requires an approved template (configured in Meta Business, not in this screen). 3) If your reply fails, check Meta Manager / error logs — often it is outside the allowed window or a template issue. This is WhatsApp policy, not email.
